executive_decision.one_paragraph_thesis_en: Gold is trading at $4520, up 0.85%, supported by a weaker DXY at 103.96, creating a bullish backdrop. Key pullback entry zones lie near $4490‑$4500 with resistance around $4550‑$4560. A disciplined risk plan sets stop‑loss below $4475 and profit targets at $4580‑$4600. This synthesis guides a cautious buy on pullback approach.
